gloss: fresh cream; heavy cream; whipping cream

definitions.gloss: fresh cream; heavy cream; whipping cream
definitions.explanation: Cream made from milk fat that has not been processed with additives or plant-based substitutes. Used in cooking, baking, and as a topping for desserts and drinks.

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|なま}クリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I spread fresh cream on the cake.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}クリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てて→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧、ホイップ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Whip the fresh cream to make whipped cream.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生|なま}クリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧な⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧だ。
examples.english: This pasta sauce uses plenty of fresh cream, giving it a rich flavor.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw, fresh, unprocessed) + ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧ (cream). The ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ prefix distinguishes it from processed or plant-based cream substitutes.

USAGE:
In Japan, {生|なま}クリーム specifically refers to cream made purely from milk fat (typically 35-47% fat content), as opposed to cheaper substitutes that contain vegetable oils.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|なま}クリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧ (to whip fresh cream)
- {生|なま}クリーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (to add fresh cream)
- {生|なま}クリーム⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧ (lots of fresh cream)
